title: Internal insulation.
officialText:
Materials used as internal insulation and exposed to the airstream in ducts shall be shown to be durable
when tested in accordance with UL 181. Exposed internal insulation that is not impermeable to water shall not be used to line ducts
or plenums from the exit of a cooling coil to the downstream end of the drain pan.
SECTION MC 605
AIR FILTERS
